text: {"findings":[{"rule":"H1","where":"Deployment._configureModules (calls compliance.removeModule(address(maxBalanceModule)) after super)","severity":"HIGH","why":"The override unbinds MaxBalanceModule right after the base setup sets the 1000 cap. ModularCompliance.canTransfer then only consults CountryRestrictModule, so nothing limits any investor's balance.","steps":"setUp runs; agent calls token.mint(a1, 5000), which passes isVerified and canTransfer, so a1 holds 5000 against a cap of 1000. Any verified holder can also receive more than 1000 via transfer."},{"rule":"H2","where":"Deployment._configureModules (MaxBalanceModule removed from compliance)","severity":"HIGH","why":"With the module unbound, no per-identity cap is checked. a1 and a2 share identity idA, but together they can hold far more than 1000.","steps":"agent mints 1000 to a1 and 1000 to a2 (both under idA); both succeed, so identity idA holds 2000."},{"rule":"H3","where":"Deployment._configureModules / ModularCompliance.transferred, created, destroyed","severity":"MEDIUM","why":"Once MaxBalanceModule is removed from _modules, it no longer receives moduleMintAction, moduleTransferAction or moduleBurnAction. Its _IDBalance records stay frozen and diverge from real token balances.","steps":"agent mints 500 to b; token.balanceOf(b) is 500 but maxBalanceModule.getIDBalance(compliance, idB) is 0."}]}
